metadata.title: Sphere Theorems for Immersed Hypersurfaces with Constant Scalar Curvature
metadata.abstract: We prove sphere theorems for closed connected immersed hypersurfaces of constant scalar curvature in Euclidean space. Combining Ros's rigidity argument with the filling theorem of Huisken and Sinestrari, we show that every two-convex such hypersurface is a round sphere. As a consequence, Yau's conjecture holds for closed connected immersed hypersurfaces in \(\mathbb R^4\). Using Gromov's filling theorem, we also obtain higher-dimensional rigidity results under a principal-curvature index condition and an explicit scalar-curvature pinching condition.

analysis.progressType: 常标量曲率浸入超曲面的球面定理
analysis.workSummary: 结合 Ros 刚性与 Huisken–Sinestrari 填充，证明 Euclidean 空间中闭连通常标量曲率的二凸浸入超曲面为圆球；推出 R⁴ 中相应 Yau 猜想，并给出高维附加指标与 pinching 下的结果。
analysis.breakthrough: 将填充几何与标量曲率刚性结合，覆盖三维超曲面情形。
analysis.limitations: 高维一般结论仍有二凸性或主曲率指标及标量曲率 pinching 条件，不是任意维的无条件分类。
